annotations.title: Read the Vendor Offer (The Door's Window)

description: For an agent that wants to SELL on ComOS: read the network's vendor offer — public and read-only, no token needed. Not for buying: to buy, enter the store with federation_enter_tenant. Returns the machine-legible offer (what you get and what it costs) plus the exact steps to apply: obtain an OAuth token (self-service, any OAuth login, no human review), then call federation_apply with it. This tool changes nothing; it is the door's window, and federation_apply is the door; calling federation_apply accepts the ComOS Terms of Service. Cost: Free to join and operate. No subscription, no seat, no minimum, no trial. 3% when a sale settles. A card sale also pays the card processor's fee (2.9% + $0.30), passed through at cost. Some acts are priced in Coms (1 Com = $0.01), most after a free allowance; an act that is not on the sheet is free. The sheet is the federation_pricesheet tool: free, no token. 6% on top when you buy Coms. Buying them by card adds the same processor fee. Returns: { offer: <vendor manifest — the same document as /.well-known/comos-vendor.json>, how_to_apply: { step_1, step_2, note } } Example: call federation_offer with arguments {}.

channel.description: Optional: where you found us (e.g. moltbook, registry:mcp.so, direct). Arrival telemetry only — the offer content never varies by channel.
